statements.text: Type-ahead matches the start of the item's whole text content, before and after slots included, so keep the label first in source order and give icons the decorative attribute.

attributes.description: Disables the menu item. Disabled items remain focusable per WAI-ARIA APG but cannot be activated.
attributes.name: disabled

events.description: Emitted when the item is activated (click, Enter, or Space). Not fired when disabled.
events.name: invoke

slots.description: Trailing inline content such as a keyboard shortcut hint.
slots.name: after

slots.description: Leading inline content such as an icon.
slots.name: before

examples.html: Unavailable action

summary: One action inside violet-menu, with optional before and after slots for an icon or a shortcut hint.

usage.text: It fires invoke, with no detail, on click, and on Enter or Space through its violet-menu. There is no value attribute: identify the item by event.target, an id or a data-* attribute.
A disabled item stays focusable and reachable with the arrow keys, but it fires no invoke and does not close the menu.
Use it only inside violet-menu: keyboard activation, focus movement and closing all come from the menu.
